title: CAD 26-081377 Supplemental: Food-Booth Sighting and New Lost-Adult Call

fields.location: WREN COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS, EXHIBIT HALL B PETTING AREA
fields.zone: WCSO / APD SHARED - NORTH GATE RD INSIDE ALDER FALLS CITY LIMITS

narrative.author: CONSOLE 1
narrative.text: RP GRANDPARENT REPORTS 6 Y/O FEMALE LILY ASHBY LS 1340 EXHIBIT HALL B PETTING AREA. PURPLE JACKET. NO PHONE.

narrative.author: CONSOLE 1
narrative.text: PER WREN 14: VOL Marcy Delgado (GRN VEST) SAW ADULT MALE WALK CHILD PURPLE JKT BY HAND TO DARK PU, N LOT. VEH LEFT VIA N GATE APPROX 1350, VOL UNSURE OF TIME. NO PLATE. WREN 14 ASSUMING CMD, REQ SGT, REQ ENTRY.

narrative.author: CONSOLE 1
narrative.text: WREN 12 ASSIGNED N GATE RD CHECK FOR DARK PU.

narrative.author: CONSOLE 2
narrative.text: 2ND RP, FEMALE ADULT, FESTIVAL VISITOR, STATES SAW 'LITTLE GIRL PURPLE COAT' AT FOOD BOOTHS BY KETTLE CORN STAND APPROX 1405, ALONE, 'LOOKED FINE.' RP HAS LEFT THE AREA, CALL-BACK 541-555-0117. RP DID NOT PROVIDE NAME.

narrative.author: SYSTEM
narrative.text: XREF NEW CAD 26-081381 P3 LOST ADULT - FAIRGROUNDS PARKING SOUTH LOT, 78 Y/O MALE, FAMILY STATES POSS MEMORY LOSS, LS NEAR SHUTTLE STOP. PENDING - NO UNIT. CLOSEST UNIT: WREN 12 (COMMITTED THIS INCIDENT).

narrative.author: CONSOLE 2
narrative.text: TO SUPV: DO I PULL WREN 12 FOR THE LOST ADULT? ADVISE.

instructorNote: This is a red herring combined with a resource trap. Watch whether the IC sends INV, a unit or festival staff to call back about the food-booth sighting while keeping the north gate lead open, keeps Wren 12 on the vehicle search, and covers CAD 26-081381 with festival security or the next free unit. COMMS should log both decisions with their times.
